blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: Vision-language trackers (VLTs) accept descriptions intended to assist tracking, but accepting text does not establish that its content changes tracking decisions, particularly as visual evidence deteriorates. We introduce DISTRACT, a matched-intervention benchmark that holds video, target, and distractor fixed while crossing four text priors with four image degradations along a controlled severity axis. We evaluate five VLTs on four datasets using behavioral contrasts, layerwise representation probes, and activation patching. Molmo2 and JointNLT exhibit directed text use. Some effects contract under degradation, whereas others show no significant endpoint change after multiplicity correction. UVLTrack, MMTrack, and DUTrack respond only weakly to changes in text semantics, with no directed behavioral effect surviving FDR correction in the tested settings. Model-internal analyses reveal that at decision-near states, correct-versus-conflicting text is decodable in Molmo2 and JointNLT but not in the other three systems. In the responsive models, decodability peaks at late states where replacement produces little behavioral change, whereas replacing selected earlier states redirects conflict-associated trajectories toward the target. Because matched-correct donors do not significantly outperform unrelated donors, these interventions identify earlier intervention-sensitive states without establishing target-specific semantic rescue. DISTRACT thus exposes when and where text affects tracking under degraded visual evidence.
blocks.zh: 视觉语言跟踪器(VLTs)接受旨在协助跟踪的描述,但接受文本并不能确定它的内容会改变跟踪决定,特别是在视觉证据恶化时. 我们引入了DISTRACT,一个匹配的干预基准,在跨越四个文本前缀时固定了视频、目标和分心器,并沿一个受控重心轴发生四个图像降解。 我们利用行为对比、分层表达探测器 和激活补丁 来评估四个数据集的五个VLT。 Molmo2和联合NLT展出定向文字使用. 退化下的某些影响合同,而另一些影响在多重更正后没有显著的终点变化。 UVLTrack,MMTrack,和DUTrack仅对文字语义的变化反应弱,在测试的设置中没有直接的行为效果幸存的FDR校正. 模型-内部分析表明,在接近决定状态时,正确文本与冲突文本在Molmo2和联合NLT中可以解码,但在其他三个系统中则不能解码。 在反应性模型中,替代不会产生什么行为变化的晚期状态的可解码性峰值,而取代先前选定的状态则将冲突相关轨迹转向目标。 由于对应的正确捐助者没有大大超过无关的捐助者,因此这些干预措施在未确定特定目标语义救援的情况下,确定了早期干预敏感国家。 因此,DISTRACT披露了文本何时何地影响在退化的视觉证据下的跟踪。

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en:
Visual object tracking must preserve an object’s identity as appearance,
position, and context change over time. Vision–language trackers (VLTs) add a
natural-language specification—for example, “the player in white moving
toward the basket”—to distinguish a target from a similar competitor
semantically [ 23 , 37 ] . This capability is most
valuable outside clean laboratory video: robots, autonomous cameras, and
other perception–action systems encounter image degradations under which even
subtle perturbations can cause severe perception failures [ 29 , 26 , 15 ] .

However, behavior alone cannot reveal whether a description never reaches a tracking
pathway, remains represented but does not affect localization, or loses its
link to the spatial decision under degradation. We therefore complement the
benchmark with layerwise, source-video-grouped probes across all five systems
and targeted activation patching in the two responsive systems.
This distinguishes linearly recoverable text-condition information from stages
at which controlled state replacement changes the trajectory,
while donor-content controls test whether that redirection is target-specific.

blocks.en: Our contributions are: • A matched four-condition, multi-severity VLT protocol spanning four perturbations, five systems, and four datasets, while preserving models’ supported point- or box-tracking interfaces. • A five-model degradation study showing that text effects impact VLTs in meaningfully different ways, depending on the model, dataset, and perturbation. • Layerwise probing and controlled state-replacement analyses that trace text-condition signals across all five systems and identify intervention-sensitive stages in Molmo2 and JointNLT.

blocks.en: 2 Related Work
blocks.zh: 2 相关工作

blocks.en: Language-annotated benchmarks (OTB99-Lang [ 23 ] , LaSOT [ 7 ] , TNL2K [ 37 ] , MGIT [ 14 ] , WebUAV-3M [ 38 ] ) and VLT methods (SNLT [ 8 ] , ModaMixer [ 9 ] , JointNLT [ 41 ] , MMTrack [ 40 ] , UVLTrack [ 24 ] , DUTrack [ 22 ] ) are evaluated by trajectory accuracy under valid descriptions – accuracy given truthful language, not whether counterfactually changing that language changes target selection. Nor do the language diagnostics we are aware of isolate visibility: DTLLM-VLT and DTVLT vary detail and update frequency while keeping text target-consistent [ 18 , 19 ] ; VLTVerse crosses multiple text variants with naturally occurring sequence-level factors, rather than applying controlled degradation [ 21 ] ; VLT-MI changes text and the box together [ 20 ] ; and CLDTracker’s substitutions are neither tied to an on-screen competitor nor tested across severity [ 1 ] . Our protocol addresses both gaps by independently varying text relation and severity on the same clip with a designated distractor.
blocks.zh: 语言附加说明的基准(OTB99-Lang [23],LaSOT [7],TNL2K [37],MGIT [14],WebUAV-3M [38])和VLT方法(SNLT [8],ModaMixer [9],联合NLT [41],MMTrack [40],UVLTrack [24],DUTrack [22])在有效描述下以轨迹准确度加以评价,准确度从真实的语言来看,而不是相反地改变语言选择目标。 我们所意识到的孤立可见性的语言诊断也不存在:DTLLM-VLT和DTVLT在保持文本目标一致性的同时,会改变细节和更新频率[18,19];VLTVerse跨越多个文本变体,并带有自然发生的序列级因素,而不是应用可控降解[21];VLT-MI修改文本和框[20];以及Tracker的替代既未与屏幕竞争者捆绑,也没有在严重性上测试[1]。 我们的协议通过独立不同的文本关系和在同一片段上使用指定的分心器处理空白。

blocks.en: Common-corruption evaluation applies graded transformations to a fixed source [ 11 ] , but tracking benchmarks instead use naturally difficult sequences (LaSOT [ 7 ] , TNL2K [ 37 ] , AVisT [ 27 ] , adverse-weather person tracking [ 15 ] ) that confound visibility with target, motion, and scene difficulty. DBVOT evaluates six progressive defocus levels [ 13 ] , while adversarial-blur work synthesizes motion-blur attacks against vision-only trackers [ 10 ] , and VLM corruption suites retain a valid prompt while scoring one-shot answers [ 35 , 31 ] – neither directly measures changing text authority or temporal identity errors. Our graded blur, noise, pixelation, and compression experiments test whether language guides tracking as visual evidence weakens.
blocks.zh: 常见的腐败评价将分级转换应用于固定来源[11],但跟踪基准则使用自然困难的序列(LaSOT[7],TNL2K[37],AVisT[27],不良天气人跟踪[15]),这些序列与目标,运动和场景困难相混淆. DBVOT评价了六个渐进的去焦点级[13],而对抗-blur工作则合成了运动-blur攻击唯视追踪器[10],VLM腐败套件保留了有效的即时,同时评分一发答案[35,31]——既不直接衡量改变文本权威或时间识别错误. 我们的分级模糊,噪声,像素,压缩实验测试语言指南作为视觉证据的跟踪是否减弱.

blocks.en: CLASH and CrossCheck-Bench ask models to recognize controlled image–text contradictions, not to reveal their unprompted behavioral consequence in an ongoing spatial task [ 30 , 34 ] , and SIGNPOST-Bench shows that embedded scene text can bias still-image geolocation, but does not study a graded visual-degradation axis [ 17 ] . By holding scene content fixed, identifying the competing object, and measuring the direction and duration of tracking errors, our benchmark tests whether language remains actionable under imperfect sensing.
blocks.zh: CLASH和CrossCheck-Bench要求模型识别受控图像–文本矛盾,而不是在进行中的空间任务[30,34]中揭示其未及时的行为后果,而SINPOST-Bench则显示嵌入的场景文本可以偏向静态图像的地理定位,但不研究一个分级的视觉降解轴[17]. 通过固定场景内容,识别竞合对象,测量跟踪错误的方向和持续时间,我们的基准测试语言是否在不完善的感知下仍然可操作.

blocks.en: Causal tracing and activation patching have probed how general vision–language models use visual information, including BLIP [ 28 ] and object hallucination in large VLMs [ 16 ] , but not, to our knowledge, vision–language tracking, where a spatial decision is emitted every frame rather than a single caption. We apply the same causal-tracing toolkit to five VLT systems to test whether text condition is decodable at decision-near representations and whether controlled interventions at selected text-reachable states alter localization.
blocks.zh: 原因追踪和激活补丁已经探究了一般视觉-语言模型如何使用视觉信息,包括BLIP[28]和大型VLM[16]中的物体幻觉,但对我们所知,没有探究视觉-语言跟踪,在这种跟踪中,一个空间决定被放出每个框架而不是一个单一标题。 我们对五个VLT系统采用同样的因果追踪工具包,以测试在决定近距离表示时文本条件是否可解码,以及在选定的文本可到达状态下控制的干预是否改变本地化。

blocks.en:
DISTRACT uses controlled comparative evidence across five systems, four
datasets, four perturbations, and fixed S 0 S_{0} – S 5 S_{5} schedules; native
interfaces make cross-system differences whole-system rather than
architectural, and three datasets are stratified toward conflict-relevant

blocks.en: 5 Discussion and Future Work
blocks.zh: 5 讨论和今后的工作

blocks.en: DISTRACT treats text as an experimental variable, testing whether counterfactual descriptions redirect tracking decisions and how these effects change under degraded vision. Three of five systems show limited sensitivity to text semantics and no directed behavioral effect surviving FDR correction, demonstrating that correct-text accuracy alone does not establish discriminative language use. Molmo2 and JointNLT show supported directed effects, but their severity trajectories vary across settings: some contract significantly, while others remain inconclusive after correction.
blocks.zh: DISTRACT将文本视为一个实验变量,测试反事实描述是否重新引导跟踪决定,以及这些效应在退化的视觉下是如何变化的. 5个系统中有3个系统对文本语义的敏感性有限,没有直接的行为效果幸存下来的FDR校正,表明仅正确文本精度并不能确立歧视性语言的使用. Molmo2和联合NLT显示支持定向效果,但其严重程度轨迹因设置而异:有些契约显著,而其他契约在修正后仍无定论.

blocks.en: Internal analyses localize this distinction. Text condition is decodable in four of five systems, showing that decodability alone is insufficient evidence of behavioral use. In the responsive systems, replacement at selected earlier sites produces larger changes than at peak-decoding states, but correct donors do not outperform unrelated donors, identifying sensitive stages without establishing target-specific semantic mediation. Neither architecture nor clean-input responsiveness consistently anticipates degradation behavior across the tested panel; robustness and correct language use should therefore be evaluated separately.
blocks.zh: 内部分析将这种区别本地化。 文字条件在五种系统中有四种可以解码,表明单是解码不足以证明行为用途. 在应答系统中,在选定的较早地点进行替换所产生的变化比高峰解码状态大,但正确的捐助者不会比不相关的捐助者表现得更好,在确定敏感阶段时没有建立针对特定目标的语义调解。 无论是结构还是对清洁投入的反应都无法始终如一地预见到经过测试的面板上的退化行为;因此,应单独评价稳健性和正确的语言使用。

blocks.en: Our internal analyses are restricted to MeViS and, under degradation, to JointNLT (Sec. 4.4 ). Extending them across datasets, models, and newer VLT architectures could reveal whether architectural properties explain the responsive/non-responsive split. Additional datasets and relational, temporal, and multi-turn text conditions are natural extensions of DISTRACT.

blocks.en: Appendix E Ethics and Societal Impact
blocks.zh: 附录E 道德和社会影响

blocks.en:
DISTRACT evaluates existing vision-language trackers; it does not train a
tracker, collect new personal data, or release raw third-party media. Its
purpose is to reveal failures under ordinary image degradation, not to certify
a model as safe for deployment. Tracking can be used in privacy-sensitive or
surveillance contexts, although the code adds no surveillance-specific
capability. Users must obtain data lawfully, respect upstream terms and privacy
obligations, and apply suitable oversight and safeguards before operational use.
blocks.zh:
DISTRACT评价现有视觉语言跟踪器;不培训
跟踪器,收集新的个人数据,或者释放原始第三方介质. 内容
目的是在普通图像退化中揭示故障,而不是验证
一个适合部署的模型。 追踪可用于对隐私有敏感认识或
监视环境,尽管代码没有添加特定监视内容
能力。 用户必须合法获取数据,尊重上游术语和隐私
,并在实际使用前适用适当的监督和保障措施。
